llm.summary: This interview-coaching skill is not malicious, but it automatically stores detailed local records of users' interview answers and uses unsafe user-controlled filenames.

dimensions.detail: Local persistence under ~/.claude/ai-interview/ is coherent with performance tracking, but full transcript retention is broader than necessary for basic interview practice and may capture proprietary or personal content.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single Markdown skill with frontmatter metadata and no bundled executable code, dependencies, remote payload retrieval, or install-time scripts.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill instructs the agent to save exact user answers, scores, feedback, timestamps, and improvement plans automatically, without an explicit opt-in or deletion/retention controls.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Profiles and session notebooks persist across runs, filenames include user-provided username/domain values, and the skill provides shell-style examples without validation or containment guidance.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The core interview coaching, scoring, adaptive questions, and performance tracking match the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review this skill before installing if you may discuss confidential interview questions, employer code, personal history, or proprietary designs. It should be changed to ask before saving, store summaries by default, validate profile names/domains, avoid shell interpolation, and provide a clear way to delete saved profiles and sessions.
llm.findings:
[SQP-2] unexpected: Artifact evidence supports the concern: sessions are automatically saved and include exact user answers; this goes beyond minimal scoring and lacks explicit consent or retention controls.
[RA2] expected: Persistent profiles are purpose-aligned for adaptive practice, but the automatic full-session persistence makes the overall persistence design a Review concern rather than benign guidance only.
[SSD-3] unexpected: The skill builds durable records of ability scores, weak topics, session history, and exact answers without minimization or expiry, so the scanner concern is supported by the artifact.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Saving full Q&A notebooks with exact answers is disclosed in the body, but it is under-controlled and not necessary for the core coaching function.
[T09] unexpected: The artifact constructs profile/session paths and an ls command using username and domain placeholders without validation, creating plausible path traversal or shell-injection risk in agents that execute the instructions literally.
